description: [Increment 1: Assumptions] Write Chapter 2 (Literature Review) in thesis.md. Cover Reinforcement Learning basics, Q-Learning algorithm derivation, and Tic-Tac-Toe as a game environment. Cite foundational RL texts and recent survey papers.

[Increment 1: Assumptions] Write Chapter 1 (Introduction) in thesis.md. Define the problem, thesis statement (Q-learning convergence to Nash equilibrium in zero-sum finite games against random opponents), and project scope.
Chapter 3 (Rozdział 3: Metodyka Badań i Implementacja) in thesis.md
[Increment 2: Method] Implement the TicTacToeEnv class in src/game_env.py with reset, step, get_valid_moves, encode_state, and decode_state methods as defined in interfaces.
[Increment 2: Method] Implement the QAgent class in src/q_agent.py with init, get_action, learn_step, and update_epsilon methods as defined in interfaces.
[Increment 2: Method] Implement the get_random_move function in src/random_opponent.py as defined in interfaces.
[Increment 2: Method] Write unit tests for TicTacToeEnv in tests/test_game_env.py. Verify reset state, valid moves, win conditions (via step), draw conditions, and encode/decode consistency.

[Increment 2: Method] Write unit tests for QAgent in tests/test_q_agent.py. Verify Q-table initialization shape, epsilon-greedy action selection against valid_moves, and learn_step updates with correct reward values.

[Increment 3: Experiment] Implement the run_experiment function in src/experiment_runner.py. It must seed numpy, train Q-agent against random opponent for NUM_EPISODES_Q, evaluate win rates for both agents over NUM_EVALUATION_GAMES episodes, and write results.csv to the workspace root (os.getcwd()) with columns method, metric, value.

[Increment 3: Experiment] Implement the plot_results function in src/plot_results.py. It reads results.csv from the workspace root, generates convergence plots and comparison charts, and saves them to the figures/ directory.

[Increment 3: Text] Write Chapter 4 (Experimental Results) and Chapter 5 (Conclusions) in thesis.md. Analyze the convergence of Q-learning, compare win rates against random baseline, discuss limitations and future work.
